{{Top|leg}}
'''Prefsbelt Green''' was a location on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] below the [[Twelve Mounts]]. Following graduation from the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt Naval Academy]], [[Midshipman/Legends|midshipmen]] would be conveyed by [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] from the Incline of the Twelve Mounts to the bustling Prefsbelt Green, where they would ascend a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] to [[Prefsbelt Black]] to receive deployment orders and [[Warship/Legends|warship]] assignments.
